lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You really put yourself through the wringer with that last fight.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Anyway, it's good that you made it out alive.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Let's cut to the chase. The reason I called you here in such a hurry

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: was because I've received instructions from the Central Government.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Instructions?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You're the only Commander who has survived multiple encounters with Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You're the first to come in contact with the Pilgrims and the Heretics,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: and witness an altercation between them.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You're also the first to see one of their former subordinates become a Heretic.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Therefore, some key personnel in the Central Government have come to a decision.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Considering how often you have come into contact with living beings up on the surface

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: you and your squad are being appointed as Special Commandos.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Special Commandos?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Simply put, you'll have more autonomy when it comes to your missions.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: No one under the rank of Deputy Chief may issue you an order of any kind.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You may also refuse any order issued by the upper ranks, provided there is a justifiable reason for doing so.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: So long as you maintain regular reports, no one can touch you.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I should also mention that, if you were so inclined, you are also entitled to conceal information.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Ah yes, and the CEOs of the Big Three have no power over you whatsoever. That was my own suggestion.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: But you are still stationed at the Outpost.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You've come a long way in such a short span of time. You were the only logical choice.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: From now on, you will live in the Outpost, where you may investigate all beings above ground as you see fit.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: In regards to the Ark, you are free to come and go as you please.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: As for now, you and your squad get to enjoy a month's vacation.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You've all been through a lot. Take this as an opportunity to rest and recuperate.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I realize you have a lot on your plate and want to get started, but for now, rest. That's an order.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: ... I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I was hoping that you would be able to slip under the Central Government's radar.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: But now, their ambition devours all.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That's why I sent you to the Outpost in the first place. Out of sight, out of mind.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I didn't expect you to do so well so quickly and end up drawing attention to yourself.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: That'll be all. I'm due for a lunch meeting.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Keep up the good work.
